note: Written BEFORE any TEST-38 artifact of either arm exists. The evidential TEST-38 per-crop pass had not been launched at declaration time; outputs/gsr_srv/koshkina_percrop_v7e_v6det did not exist.
purpose: Confirmatory retest, on the held-out TEST-38 split, of the v7 V3 near-miss (results/GSR_V7_V3.md: DEV-20 +1.2562 at 11/20, gate required 12/20) and of the V4s2 fallback association point (results/GSR_V7_V4S2.md: DEV-20 +0.4853 at 12/20). Both DEV results were selected after multi-point sweeps, which is exactly the hyperparameter-selection exposure a held-out confirmatory read exists to price.

ARM1.name: edl_fuse94
ARM1.description: the v6 chain with the evidential gate head's votes swapped in -- the V3 arm verbatim

ARM2.name: edl_fuse94_w07
ARM2.description: ARM 1 plus the V4s2 fallback association point

dev20_on_record.note: never measured as a combination on DEV-20; its two halves are +1.2562 (V3) and +0.4853 (V4s2) measured separately

frozen_as_measured: No threshold, rule key or association parameter above may be re-tuned in this session. Exactly two arms are scored on TEST-38. There is no third arm and no threshold surgery.

test38_v6.requirement: re-derived on this session's stack FIRST; must reproduce 49.4970 to the digit or the push stops

test49_v6.use: control for the single test-49 run, which happens only if an arm ships

hypotheses.H1: ARM 1 beats the re-derived v6 TEST-38 control on per-sequence paired GS-HOTA.
hypotheses.H2: ARM 2 beats the re-derived v6 TEST-38 control on per-sequence paired GS-HOTA.

test.statistic: one-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank (alternative='greater') on the 38 per-sequence GS-HOTA deltas, arm minus control
test.multiplicity: Bonferroni over the two registered arms

ship_rule: The higher-scoring arm that clears its FULL gate ships. If both clear, ARM 2 ships only if its TEST-38 GS-HOTA exceeds ARM 1's; otherwise the simpler arm (ARM 1) ships. If NEITHER clears, the push ends: v7 ships nothing, the result is reported as the final registered negative, and no third arm and no re-tuned threshold is run.

if_an_arm_ships.test49: ONE test-49 run of the shipping arm (server evidential votes for the 49 test sequences + the arm chain), controls re-derived against the v6 test-49 53.0846
if_an_arm_ships.package: results/gsr_submission/gsr_testphase_gtfree_v7_<hash>.zip built to the FULL v6 standard: zip self-score identical to the scored arm, GT-free legitimacy audit MATERIALIZED as a JSON artifact, manifest carrying every component md5
if_an_arm_ships.upload: nothing is uploaded; that is Sid's action

guards.concentration: results/GSR_V5.md 2.1 -- a gain whose two best sequences carry >= 80% of the net is demoted (reported, not gate-bearing here since the gate is breadth-based)
guards.same_machine_pairing: results/CLUSTER_MIGRATION.md -- the TEST-38 GPU artifacts of BOTH arms and of the control come from a100server1; every CPU stage of all three runs on the laptop
guards.box_subdir: tools.gsr_eiou.BOX_SUBDIR must be rebound to detbox_cache_v6det (the GSR_V7_V3.md 2.7 landmine); the harness raises if the cache is absent
guards.downstream_rebuild: every arm rebuilds identity bundles, the GTA connector arm and the densified votes (clear_arm_caches), so no arm inherits another's partition
guards.metrics_version: unchanged -- the reader and the association are pipeline stages, not shipped metrics

components.code_md5_note: tools/gsr_v7_edl.py is extended in this session with --split / --out-dir / --eiou / --control plumbing so a TEST-38 arm can run at all; the extension is default-preserving and the post-edit md5 is recorded in results/GSR_V7_PUSH.md.

percrop_pass.reason: the V3 arm verbatim: the external legibility gate is OFF at crop time and applied at aggregation time by the rule's min_legibility 0.5

not_done_by_declaration: no TEST-38 read of either arm
no change to the detector, the trunk reader, the solver or the connector tau
